headline: COP31 Host Turkey Urges Higher Climate Spending Over Defense Budgets
summary: The host of the UN COP31 climate summit, Turkey, encouraged wealthy nations to spend more on climate support than on defense, amid its own renewable energy investments.
why: Shifts in international public spending priorities between defense and climate initiatives can direct major fiscal allocations toward green infrastructure.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Calls for prioritized climate spending could influence sovereign fiscal commitments to green energy sectors.
